title.zh: S&P 500 Plunges, Wall Street Fears Circuit Breaker, Just One Day After Trump Celebrated Record Highs
title.en: S&P 500 Plunges, Wall Street Fears Circuit Breaker, Just One Day After Trump Celebrated Record Highs

current_state.zh: The S&P 500 dropped as much as 3.8% on Thursday, putting market-wide circuit-breaker levels in focus just a day after Trump touted record highs, with AI and semiconductor stocks leading losses as investors digested Democratic midterm wins.
